segment.source: Auto-scan CLI coding agents with capability-driven settings, isolated accounts, alerts, and session migration.
segment.target: 自动扫描主流 CLI 智能体并按能力动态配置，支持多订阅账户隔离、等待提醒与会话迁移。
SSH 隧道与跨设备远程

segment.source: Manage ~/.ssh/config, SSH/Mosh/Telnet, port forwarding, and encrypted LAN or relay remote devices.
segment.target: 管理 ~/.ssh/config、SSH/Mosh/Telnet 与端口转发，支持局域网及加密中转远程协作。

segment.source: Built-in Jaunt JS runtime and usage tracking; compiled with .NET NativeAOT for fast startup.
segment.target: 内置 Jaunt JS 插件运行时与用量统计插件；.NET NativeAOT 编译，启动迅速、低内存占用。

segment.source: Every device signed in to your account, and the password other devices of the account use to get into this computer.
segment.target: 登录同一账号的所有设备，以及账号下其他设备进入这台电脑时要输入的访问密码。

segment.source: Sign in with the account button at the top of the window.
segment.target: 在窗口顶部的账号按钮里登录。

segment.source: Off: the account's other devices see this computer as offline.
segment.target: 关闭后，账号下的其他设备会看到这台电脑离线。

segment.source: Sign in to an account (top of the window) to see its devices and to let them in with the access password.
segment.target: 登录账号（窗口顶部）后，才能看到账号下的设备，并让它们用访问密码进入这台电脑。

segment.source: This computer is not reachable through the relay: the account's other devices see it as offline.
segment.target: 这台电脑没有经中转服务开放访问，账号下的其他设备会看到它离线。

segment.source: A device signed in to the same account types it once to get in; it is remembered afterwards and can be revoked under Remote access. The password never leaves this computer.
segment.target: 同一账号下的设备第一次访问这台电脑时输入一次，之后会被记住，可以在「远程访问」里撤销。密码不会离开这台电脑，也不会发给服务器。

segment.source: Let devices of the account in with the password
segment.target: 允许同账号设备用密码访问

segment.source: Off: only pairing by comparing numbers or a pairing link.
segment.target: 关闭后只能用核对数字或配对链接来配对。

segment.source: {0} device(s) got in with the password
segment.target: 已有 {0} 台设备用访问密码授权

segment.source: A new random one, or one you choose: exactly 8 letters and digits.
segment.target: 随机生成一个新的，或者自己设定：必须是 8 位字母或数字。

segment.source: The access password must be exactly 8 letters (A–Z) and digits. Case, spaces and dashes do not count.
segment.target: 访问密码必须正好是 8 位字母（A–Z）或数字，不区分大小写，空格和连字符不计。

segment.source: When the password changes, also revoke the devices that got in with the old one
segment.target: 更换密码时，同时撤销用旧密码授权的设备

segment.source: Too many wrong passwords: password access is paused. Check the devices under Remote access, then turn it back on.

segment.source: A computer you get into here appears among the remote hosts and in the location list of New project.

segment.source: Shown on that computer under Settings → Account & devices.
segment.target: 在那台电脑的「设置 → 账号与设备」里可以看到访问密码。

segment.source: Too many wrong passwords from this computer. Try again in about 15 minutes.
segment.target: 这台设备输错次数过多，请约 15 分钟后再试。

segment.target: 声明 terminal/* 回调，允许 ACP 智能体通过 Octopus 创建与监控命令执行（默认关闭）。
